how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-teldrassil-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:475:obj:0: Seek out Gaerolas Talvethren in Starbreeze Village.⟦1⟧
rows.quest:475:details:0: A troubling breeze blows through the forest.
rows.quest:475:details:1: BGaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with ⟦E1⟧ remains fulfilled.
rows.quest:475:details:2: BBut word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous. ⟦E2⟧ east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.
rows.quest:475:completion:0: Thank the forest spirits you are here! I knew Athridas would sense trouble and send help.
rows.quest:476:obj:0: Return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:476:details:0: The Gnarlpine tribe has been corrupted!
rows.quest:476:details:1: BThe once peaceful furbolgs have turned against the protectors of the forest. They ambushed me as I left for the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and proceeded to pillage Starbreeze Village. Ursal the Mauler, their chieftain, is using the evil powers of the Fel Moss to drive them mad.
rows.quest:476:details:2: BI am too wounded to return to Athridas to bring him this grave news. The task is left to you, young ⟦2⟧. We can only hope that the deranged Gnarlpines have not made it to Ban'ethil yet!
rows.quest:476:completion:0: By the stars! This is quite disturbing indeed!
rows.quest:483:obj:0: Retrieve the Relics of Wakening and bring them to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:483:details:0: Gnarlpine invaders were seen ravaging the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.
rows.quest:483:details:1: BThe slumbering druids will be trapped in the Emerald Dream for eternity, unaware of their fate, unless we help. The delicate ⟦E3⟧ ritual cannot be broken without the Relics of Wakening.
rows.quest:483:details:2: BJourney to the Den and retrieve the Raven ⟦E4⟧ Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting. The druids store them in sacred chests. Return them to me and I will prepare the awakening ritual.
rows.quest:483:completion:0: You have succeeded, young ⟦3⟧! Well done. And just in time I might add.
rows.quest:486:obj:0: Kill Ursal the Mauler and return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:486:details:0: Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, ⟦4⟧, they will be forever lost in sleep.
rows.quest:486:details:1: BI shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. For my work to take effect, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.
rows.quest:486:details:2: BIt was Ursal the Mauler who meddled with our brethren's calling and it is Ursal the Mauler who must now pay so they can be freed. ⟦E2⟧ to Gnarlpine Hold in the southwest and slay him.
rows.quest:486:completion:0: ⟦5⟧ you have proven yourself a most worthy and able ⟦6⟧. A night elf who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.
rows.quest:486:completion:1: BMay the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
rows.quest:487:obj:0: Slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to Sentinel Amara Nightwalker outside of Dolanaar.
rows.quest:487:details:0: The road to ⟦E5⟧ must be kept safe. Travelers heading from Dolanaar to ⟦E5⟧ have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.
rows.quest:487:details:1: BImportant news and commerce travels to and from ⟦E5⟧ by way of this road daily. We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.
rows.quest:487:details:2: BTake up arms in the name of the sacred forest, ⟦7⟧. Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point. Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
rows.quest:487:completion:0: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and ⟦E5⟧ well, brave ⟦8⟧. As a member of the Sentinel force of ⟦E6⟧ I salute your efforts.
rows.quest:488:obj:0: Bring Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
rows.quest:488:details:0: Eager for work, I see. Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling ⟦9⟧ to perform my bidding.
rows.quest:488:details:1: BYou see, ⟦10⟧, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having. But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.
rows.quest:488:details:2: BMy business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents. Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
rows.quest:488:details:3: BLet's keep this our little secret, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:488:completion:1: BWho would have ever guessed that I, Zenn Foulhoof, would have a ⟦12⟧ to do my bidding? Certainly not me! But so it goes... this beloved world of ours is full of surprises.
rows.quest:488:completion:2: BThree cheers for the naive and gullible!
rows.quest:489:obj:0: Collect 3 Fel Cones and give them to Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar.
rows.quest:489:details:0: The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a ⟦13⟧, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures.
rows.quest:489:details:1: BYou must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:489:details:2: BTeach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. They billow with green smoke.
rows.quest:489:details:3: BGive some to Foulhoof. He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.
rows.quest:489:completion:0: Ah, what a sweet ⟦14⟧! I knew you would come in handy!
rows.quest:918:obj:0: Bring 8 Timberling Seeds to Denelan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:918:details:0: The timberlings of ⟦E6⟧ are elementals of nature. In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on our great tree.
rows.quest:918:details:1: BSo it is disturbing to see how angry the timberlings have become.
rows.quest:918:details:2: BI believe it has something to do with the soil. I have been working on different methods of nurturing plants and would like to try them on timberling seeds. Please, can you gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth and bring them to me?
rows.quest:918:completion:0: You got them. This is good!
rows.quest:918:completion:1: BI will plant these seeds in special soil I have prepared. I believe the seeds will sprout into timberlings who are much more docile. Perhaps later you can see the results!
rows.quest:919:obj:0: Bring 12 Timberling Sprouts to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:919:details:0: Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth. I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.
rows.quest:919:details:1: BWhen you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them. Help keep our land clean!
rows.quest:919:completion:0: That's a lot! I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate. I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.
rows.quest:919:completion:1: BThank you for your help, ⟦15⟧. The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
rows.quest:922:obj:0: Bring a Timberling Seed to Rellian Greenspyre in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:922:details:0: ⟦16⟧, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre? He is a druid in ⟦E5⟧, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings. He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.
rows.quest:922:details:1: BThank you, ⟦17⟧. You have been a great help to me. I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.
rows.quest:922:details:2: BYou will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:922:completion:0: Ah, a timberling seed? I wanted to try growing one of these to help Denalan with his studies.
rows.quest:922:completion:1: BBut I'm afraid I've discovered that a corruption has grown in many of the timberlings, and seeds from such creatures carry their parent's taint. They are beyond my talents to repair.
rows.quest:922:completion:2: BDenalan is very skilled with things that grow. He may find a cure for future timberlings. He may be their only hope.
rows.quest:923:obj:0: Bring 5 Mossy Tumors to Rellian Greenspyre in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:923:details:0: There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings. We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep ⟦E6⟧ safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help. Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern ⟦E6⟧ are the most tainted. They must be removed!
rows.quest:923:details:1: BDestroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them. Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
rows.quest:923:completion:0: Well done! These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease. They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.
rows.quest:923:completion:1: BI will dispose of these tumors. Thank you, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:927:obj:0: Bring the Moss-twined Heart to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:927:details:0: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.
rows.quest:927:details:1: BPerhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
rows.quest:927:completion:0: ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!
rows.quest:927:completion:1: BThank you for bringing this to me, ⟦19⟧. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.
rows.quest:929:obj:0: Fill the Jade Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:929:details:0: First, let me tell you more of the task you must complete. The druids in ⟦E5⟧ use the water of the moonwells of ⟦E6⟧, and their moonwell must be replenished from time to time. Using these specially crafted phials, you can collect the water of the moonwells.
rows.quest:929:details:1: BTake this vessel to the moonwell outside of Starbreeze Village to the east, and fill it with some of its waters, then return to me. When you have completed your task, I shall continue the story where Tenaron left off...
rows.quest:929:completion:0: After the Battle of ⟦E7⟧, we were without direction. Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.
rows.quest:929:completion:1: BIt was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. A dark time for all.
rows.quest:930:obj:0: Bring the glowing fruit to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:930:details:0: Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.
rows.quest:930:details:1: BDenalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
rows.quest:930:completion:0: You found this on ⟦E6⟧? Intriguing... this fruit is exotic. Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off. Perhaps even as far as ⟦E8⟧! And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:930:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦20⟧. Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
rows.quest:931:obj:0: Bring a Shimmering Frond to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth
rows.quest:931:details:0: The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.
rows.quest:931:details:1: BYou believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.
rows.quest:931:completion:0: Where did you get this? I haven't seen a plant like this since a sojourn I made to the ⟦E9⟧... decades ago! It's amazing that a specimen made its way to ⟦E6⟧. And it's grown to such a size!
rows.quest:931:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦21⟧. Forgive my shortness of words, but there is a test I would like to perform on this frond...
rows.quest:932:obj:0: Kill Lord Melenas and bring his head to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:932:details:0: I must warn you, ⟦22⟧, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.
rows.quest:932:details:1: BHe is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.
rows.quest:932:details:2: BYou must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
rows.quest:932:completion:0: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:933:obj:0: Fill the Tourmaline Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:933:details:0: There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to ⟦E5⟧, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.
rows.quest:933:details:1: BBe wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
rows.quest:933:completion:0: Shan'do Stormrage never returned, and the druids were in disarray, and to this day we still do not know what became of him. With Malfurion missing, Arch ⟦E10⟧ Fandral Staghelm took over the leadership of the druids, convincing the Circle of Ancients in ⟦E11⟧ that it was time for our people to rebuild, and that it was time for our people to regain their immortality.
rows.quest:933:completion:1: BWith the approval of the Circle, Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew ⟦E6⟧, the new World Tree.
rows.quest:934:obj:0: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:934:details:0: All was not well with ⟦E6⟧, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on ⟦E6⟧ may be attributed.
rows.quest:934:details:1: BHowever, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
rows.quest:934:completion:0: To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...
rows.quest:934:completion:1: BWith ⟦E6⟧ grown, the Arch ⟦E10⟧ approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, ⟦E6⟧'s growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
rows.quest:935:obj:0: Bring the Filled Vessel to Arch ⟦E10⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:935:details:0: Without the blessings of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder and Nozdormu the Timeless, ⟦E6⟧'s growth has not been without flaw. Strange beasts have been reported arising from the very ground of the tree, and crazed furbolgs attack passing travelers.
rows.quest:935:details:1: BI can only hope that the solution the Arch ⟦E10⟧ is looking for will be found quickly. I will pour all the phials you brought into this vessel, for you to deliver to ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:935:details:2: BBring it to Fandral Staghelm, you will find him in the druid grove.
rows.quest:935:completion:0: Ah yes, the water I had requested. Tenaron and Corithras certainly took their time in having it delivered... perhaps not choosing the most reliable of messengers... hmm.
rows.quest:935:completion:1: BNonetheless, I can finally get back to my work then. The weight of ⟦E6⟧'s problems fall upon my shoulders. A yoke I would wish to soon be rid of.
rows.quest:935:completion:2: BTake this, you may find some use for it.
rows.quest:937:obj:0: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
rows.quest:937:details:0: I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.
rows.quest:937:details:1: BWhen the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to ⟦E5⟧ with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.
rows.quest:937:details:2: BIf you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
rows.quest:937:completion:0: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, ⟦24⟧. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.
rows.quest:937:completion:1: BI have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
rows.quest:938:obj:0: Escort Mist to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
rows.quest:938:details:0: The sabercat's fur is a distinctive gray color, blending into the surrounding forest. As she lays there, you observe that she is badly wounded, with deep lacerations across her back and stomach.
rows.quest:938:details:1: BShe raises her head and gazes at you, bright intelligence shining in blue eyes. She seems to wish to follow you.
rows.quest:938:completion:0: Oh, thank you, ⟦25⟧! I feared I would never see Mist again, knowing only her death in my heart, never to be united with my faithful companion. I owe you more than you can know, and you have my eternal gratitude.
rows.quest:940:obj:0: Deliver the Oracle Tree's report to Arch ⟦E10⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:940:details:0: The forest whispers of your feats of valor, ⟦26⟧. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch ⟦E10⟧, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.
rows.quest:940:details:1: BDeliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
rows.quest:940:completion:0: I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.
rows.quest:940:completion:1: BI fear my work on ⟦E6⟧ shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.
rows.quest:940:completion:2: BNonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
rows.quest:941:obj:0: Plant the Tainted Heart in Denalan's Planter.
rows.quest:941:details:0: I have removed that foul moss from the heart, but it remains tainted...
rows.quest:941:details:1: BTry placing the heart in my planter. It is filled with a nutritive soil that may cleanse and heal the heart.
rows.quest:941:completion:0: You place the heart within the planter, and it quickly digs itself in!
rows.quest:941:completion:1: BA few seconds later it wriggles back out, cleansed. It pulses slightly... beckoning for you to take it.
rows.quest:997:obj:0: Bring the package of Rare Earth to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:997:details:0: Are you heading to the south? To Lake Al'Ameth? If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...
rows.quest:997:details:1: BMy colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of ⟦E6⟧. He requested a package of rare earths from ⟦E5⟧ and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:997:details:2: BCan you take the package to him?
rows.quest:997:completion:0: Ah, it's here! I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time. I hope it's still fresh...
rows.quest:997:completion:1: BThank you for bringing it to me, ⟦27⟧. You are a ⟦28⟧ who is generous with his time.
rows.quest:2159:obj:0: Bring the Dolanaar Delivery to ⟦E12⟧ Keldamyr.
rows.quest:2159:details:0: Greetings, young ⟦29⟧. Can you offer me aid? I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar. But I still have business with the druids of ⟦E13⟧ and cannot yet leave.
rows.quest:2159:details:1: BCan you deliver this package for me? It must be sent to ⟦E12⟧ Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn. It lies along the road, to the south.
rows.quest:2159:completion:0: Ah yes, the delivery of herbs from ⟦E13⟧. It is a shame Porthannius could not bring it himself, for we have much to discuss, he and I. But I am glad to get the herbs nonetheless, and I am glad you came.
rows.quest:2159:completion:1: BWhile you are here, please, rest yourself. Heroes must keep their strength and spirits high, and must find rest and solace whenever they may. For to neglect one's peace of body and mind is a sure path to failure.
rows.quest:2399:completion:0: The fronds Denalan planted within his garden have sprouted and grown. They tremble, eager to be picked....
rows.quest:2438:obj:0: Bring the Emerald Dreamcatcher to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:2438:details:0: I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.
rows.quest:2438:details:1: BSadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.
rows.quest:2438:details:2: BPerhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, ⟦30⟧?
rows.quest:2438:completion:0: My emerald dreamcatcher is of great importance to me. It is a gift only given to few. Thank you for returning it, ⟦31⟧.
rows.quest:2459:obj:0: Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar wants you to kill 7 Gnarlpine Mystics and find the Missing Jewel.
rows.quest:2459:details:0: The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!
rows.quest:2459:details:1: BThere is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.
rows.quest:2459:details:2: BFind this missing jewel, ⟦32⟧. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
rows.quest:2459:completion:0: Now I can repair my dreamcatcher. Thank you, ⟦33⟧.
rows.quest:2498:obj:0: Rellian Greenspyre wants you to speak with Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:2498:details:0: I have just received word that Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.
rows.quest:2498:details:1: BMake haste, ⟦34⟧; he needs our help.
rows.quest:2498:completion:0: Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. I am glad you arrived here so soon.
rows.quest:2498:completion:1: BI have discovered something quite disturbing!
rows.quest:2499:obj:0: Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth wants you to collect the Gargantuan Tumor from Oakenscowl.
rows.quest:2499:details:0: In a cave along the southern bank of the lake, a timberling named Oakenscowl is spreading corruption to all the creatures that make Lake Al'Ameth their home.
rows.quest:2499:details:1: BI dared not get too close, but even from a distance, it is obvious: Oakenscowl is being poisoned by the largest tumor I have ever seen... I would call it gargantuan, even.
rows.quest:2499:details:2: B⟦35⟧, you have already done much to aid my efforts, but I ask of you one more task. Hunt down Oakenscowl and collect the tumor; remove this source of corruption from my home.
rows.quest:2499:completion:0: I knew you were more than capable of ridding the lake of that horrible beast.
rows.quest:2499:completion:1: BIt is a distressing situation; Oakenscowl was once a grand leader amongst his kind... but corruption does not discriminate between the lowly and the noble.
rows.quest:2499:completion:2: BThe size of this tumor is quite disturbing, but I must study it to learn more about the disease that upsets the timberling population.
rows.quest:2541:obj:0: Bring a ⟦E14⟧ Voodoo Charm to Oben Rageclaw in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.
rows.quest:2541:details:0: The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.
rows.quest:2541:details:1: BYou must help me. The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. Please, ⟦37⟧, bring one to me.
rows.quest:2541:completion:1: BWhat an odd trinket this is... I can sense the vile aura emanating from it; this is a very powerful enchantment.
rows.quest:2561:obj:0: Oben Rageclaw wants you to kill his soulless body, and then use the Voodoo Charm.
rows.quest:2561:details:0: After examining this charm, ⟦39⟧, I see now what must be done. Please take it, and do as I ask.
rows.quest:2561:details:1: BYou are to explore the deepest areas of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. There, you will find my soulless body... Although I regret what I am about to tell you, I see no other way to free myself from the control of the Gnarlpine.
rows.quest:2561:details:2: BIn order for me to escape them, you must kill my physical form. Once that is done, use the voodoo charm on my fallen body. After you have completed this task, please return to me.
rows.quest:2561:completion:0: I am finally free of the control of the Gnarlpine. Thank you, ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:2561:completion:1: BMy spirit may now rest peacefully forever in the Emerald Dream.
rows.quest:2561:completion:2: BPerhaps one day we may meet again, young ⟦41⟧. But, for now, please accept this reward as a symbol of my gratitude.
rows.quest:7383:obj:0: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:7383:details:0: All was not well with ⟦E6⟧, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on ⟦E6⟧ may be attributed.
rows.quest:7383:details:1: BHowever, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
rows.quest:7383:completion:0: To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...
rows.quest:7383:completion:1: BWith ⟦E6⟧ grown, the Arch ⟦E10⟧ approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, ⟦E6⟧'s growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
rows.quest:8734:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ to the ⟦E15⟧ and speak to Keeper Remulos.
rows.quest:8734:details:0: Tyrande will be notifed, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.
rows.quest:8734:details:1: BNow you must venture to the ⟦E15⟧ and speak with Remulos. He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.
rows.quest:8734:details:2: BWe all wish you great luck.
rows.quest:8734:completion:0: It would be impossible to pull Eranikus from the Dream should he refuse. His intentions, however, require him to enter our world. He seeks to destroy the living manifestation of Malfurion. To do this successfully would mean an end to one of the most powerful allies of the Dream. The Nightmare would wholly consume all that would remain should Malfurion fall...
